description: Get a full NBP (Polish central bank) exchange-rate table against PLN — the latest published table by default, or the table in force on a historical date. NBP publishes only on Polish business days — on weekends/holidays the request falls back to the most recent preceding publication; effectiveDate in the response shows the date actually used. Rates data starts 2002-01-02.

date.description: Optional historical date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for the latest table.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh NBP fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

table.description: NBP table: 'a' (default) = official mid rates of ~35 major currencies, published every business day; 'b' = mid rates of ~115 less-traded currencies, published Wednesdays; 'c' = bid/ask (buy/sell) rates of major currencies, published every business day.

name: nbp_exchange_rates
title: NBP exchange-rate table
